articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: Innovator Introduces Industry’s First Quarterly Dual Directional ETFs. WHEATON, Ill., Jan. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Innovator Capital Management, LLC (Innovator), the pioneer of Defined Outcome ETFs™, today announced the launch of the industry’s first Dual Directional ETFs with quarterly outcome periods. Designed to offer the potential for positive returns in both rising and declining equity markets over 3-month periods, the new ETFs are designed to bring enhanced flexibility for investors seeking adaptive, outcome-based exposure.
